---
name: team-prd-writer
description: Write product requirement documents (PRDs) in the Northwind design team's template. Use when asked to write a spec, PRD, or feature brief for the team.
---

# Team PRD writer

Write every spec with these sections, in this order:

1. Problem
2. Who it's for
3. Goals and non-goals
4. User journeys
5. Open questions

Keep each section short. Link to research instead of pasting it.
